meta: META_ACCESS_TOKEN not set. To connect Facebook and Instagram:
1. developers.facebook.com: create an app (type Business), add the Facebook Login and Instagram Graph products.
2. Graph API Explorer: pick the app, choose the BCC Page as the token owner, grant pages_read_engagement, pages_read_user_content, read_insights, instagram_basic, instagram_manage_insights, ads_read.

3. Exchange it for a long-lived Page token (Access Token Debugger, Extend), then paste it in seo-tools/.env as META_ACCESS_TOKEN=... and put the Page id and Instagram Business id in social.json under own.
4. Meta Ad Library also needs one-time identity confirmation at facebook.com/ID before the ads_archive endpoint answers.
youtube: YOUTUBE_API_KEY not set. To connect YouTube (own channel and competitors):
1. console.cloud.google.com: any project, APIs and Services, Enable APIs, turn on YouTube Data API v3.
2. Credentials, Create credentials, API key. Restrict it to the YouTube Data API v3 only.
3. Paste it in seo-tools/.env as YOUTUBE_API_KEY=... and put the BCC channel id (UC...) or @handle in social.json under own.youtube_channel_id.
linkedin: LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN not set. LinkedIn is the hardest one and is optional:
1. linkedin.com/developers: create an app tied to the BCC Company Page, request the Community Management API (approval takes days).
2. OAuth with r_organization_social and rw_organization_admin as a Page admin; tokens last 60 days.
3. Paste it in .env as LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN=... and the numeric organization id in social.json under own.linkedin_org_id.
